name: Quick Stack and Chest Machines
description: Tap L: what you carry goes into the nearby chests that already hold it. Hold L at a chest: make it a sorting chest (whatever anyone drops in is put away into the chests that hold it), a recycler (crafted items back into part of their materials, off until switched on) or an overflow chest. /qs quick stacks for every player on your server. Gear and your action bar stay with you.

settings.label: Quick stack key
settings.help: Tap: quick stack. Hold it while looking at a chest: the chest wheel (sorting chest, recycler, ...).

settings.label: Never put away
settings.help: Parts of item names, separated by commas (torch, resin): those items stay with you.

settings.label: Only at a base
settings.help: Quick stack works only near a flame altar.

settings.label: Overflow chests
settings.help: What no chest holds goes to the nearest overflow chest (else it stays in the sorting chest).

settings.label: Recyclers
settings.help: Crafted items in a recycler go back into part of their recipe's materials. Gear stays (salvage it for runes).

settings.label: Materials back (%)
settings.help: Rounded down: recycling never gives more than the item cost.

settings.label: Materials go to a sorting chest
settings.help: The nearest sorting chest in reach gets them (else a chest in reach). Never the recycler itself: it would recycle them again.
